title: Del Ray
meta_title: Dentist Near Del Ray, Alexandria, VA | West Alexandria Dental Care
meta_description: Roughly ten to fifteen minutes from Del Ray via Braddock Road to West Alexandria Dental Care: children's dentistry, family blocks, weekend mornings.
intro: Del Ray runs along Mount Vernon Avenue north of Old Town, a neighborhood of young families, strollers and small businesses. Our office is a straightforward drive west along Braddock Road, roughly ten to fifteen minutes depending on traffic, with free parking at the door and the weekend-morning and after-school hours that families with young children actually use.

sections.heading: Who we see from Del Ray
body: Parents with toddlers due a first visit, school-age children who need sealants, and the parents themselves, who have not had a check-up since the second child arrived. Del Ray families tend to book everyone at once on a Saturday morning, which is exactly what the schedule is built for. We also see Del Ray's small-business owners and the people who work from home there, who like a 7 AM or 7 PM slot that does not interrupt the day.
See [children's dentistry](/general-dentistry/childrens-dentistry/) and [family dentistry](/general-dentistry/family-dentistry/) for how visits for different ages work.

items.title: Via Braddock Road
items.body: West on Braddock Road from Del Ray, continuing as W. Braddock Road past Quaker Lane to the Bradlee Office Building beside Bradlee Shopping Center.

items.title: Via King Street
items.body: An alternative: King Street west to W. Braddock Road.

items.title: Timing
items.body: Roughly ten to fifteen minutes outside rush hour. Weekend mornings are the quickest drive.

items.title: Parking
items.body: Free surface parking around the building, with room for a stroller to be unloaded at the door.

sections.heading: What Del Ray families most often come in for

items.title: A child's first visit
items.body: Short, calm and on the child's terms, by the first birthday or first tooth.

items.title: Sealants and fluoride
items.body: The two preventive steps that stop most childhood cavities, done at routine check-ups.

items.title: Parents' overdue check-ups
items.body: A cleaning and exam at the same visit as the children's, or a weekday evening.

items.title: Sports mouthguards and knocked-out teeth
items.body: Custom guards for the soccer and lacrosse seasons, and same-day care when a guard was not worn.

sections.heading: Practical things worth knowing
items: Open 7 AM to 8 PM Monday to Friday and 8 AM to 1 PM on Saturday and Sunday.
Aetna, Ameritas, Delta Dental, Humana, Cigna, MetLife and Virginia Medicaid accepted, including Medicaid dental coverage for children.
Care in English, Arabic, Spanish and Portuguese.
Paperwork for the whole family completed online before you arrive, through the {{forms}}.
Booking online around the clock, or by phone at {{phone}}.

sections.heading: Booking the whole family
sections.body: Call or note it in your online booking and the office arranges consecutive slots so one Saturday morning covers everyone. Parents are welcome in the room for children's visits.

faqs.q: How long is the drive from Del Ray?
faqs.a: Roughly ten to fifteen minutes west along Braddock Road, depending on traffic. Weekend mornings are quickest.

faqs.q: Can my children and I be seen on the same morning?
faqs.a: Yes. Back-to-back family appointments on Saturday and Sunday mornings are among our most common bookings. Tell us how many are coming.

faqs.q: Do you accept Medicaid for children?
faqs.a: Yes. We accept Virginia Medicaid, which covers children's dental care. Bring the child's card or upload it through the online registration.

faqs.q: Is there somewhere to park with a stroller?
faqs.a: Free surface parking surrounds the building, so you can park near the door and bring the stroller straight in.

cta.heading: One Saturday morning. The whole family seen.
cta.body: Book online at any hour or call, and ask for family appointments together.
